title: docc comments apply --format json
description: What docc comments apply did: the comments it added, removed and edited, and the files it changed. A failed batch prints no such object: it exits with code 2 and changes nothing.

added.description: The comments added, in the order of the operations.

id.description: The id of the comment: the one given, or a new one (c- and 10 characters a-z, 2-7).

path.description: The path of the document relative to src.

edited.description: Ids of the comments whose text was replaced.

files.description: The files written, relative to src, in path order.
